invariants.rationale: The method accesses 'element' fields and methods unconditionally.
'parentLayers.add(layer)' implies 'parentLayers' must be non-null when code reaches that point.
'map' is dereferenced (getProperties(), getTileSets()) and must be non-null.
If a 'tilelayer' was processed, a new layer is added to 'parentLayers'.
When 'type' is 'tilelayer', 'width' is obtained and likely positive to process layer data.
